title: Phalā
text: 3. Ānāpānasati bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave ānāpānasati katham bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 4--10. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā nisīdati- osato passati || vitthāro || yāva paṭinissaggānupassī Assasissāmīti sikkhati || paṭinissaggānupassī Passasissāmīti sikkhati || || 11. Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānasati evam bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || [page 314] 314 Ānāpāna-Saṃyuttam LIV. 12. Evam bhāvitāya kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatiyā evam bahulīkatāya dvinnam phalānam aññataram phalam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ || diṭṭheva dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā ti || ||
